items.question: Is this suitable for Indian skin?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every formula is tested on Indian skin types and developed in consultation with Indian dermatologists. We account for humidity, pollution levels, melanin-rich skin concerns (hyperpigmentation, uneven tone), and hard water effects that most K-beauty brands ignore.

items.question: What does '95% natural' mean?
items.answer: At least 95% of each formula comes from naturally derived ingredients. The remaining 5% are safe, clinically proven actives and preservatives that are necessary for product stability and efficacy. We publish our full ingredient list with source & purpose on every product page.

items.question: Do I need all 10 steps?
items.answer: No! Start with our 3-step essentials (Cleanser → Serum → Moisturizer) and build up gradually. The 10-step kit is for enthusiasts who want the full K-beauty experience. Our Skin Quiz recommends the perfect routine for your specific needs.

items.question: Is it tested on animals?
items.answer: Never. We are PETA-certified cruelty-free and 100% vegan. We use in-vitro testing and volunteer patch testing instead. No animal ingredients, no animal testing, period.
